title: Pragmatics 语用：同一句话，对谁说决定怎么说
keywords: Pragmatics 语用：同一句话，对谁说决定怎么说
brain_first: 按原文查阅 Pragmatics 语用：同一句话，对谁说决定怎么说

rows: Can you help me with this?
Could you please give me some advice?
I would appreciate it if you could...
I'm afraid I won't be able to attend.
blocks.text:
Situation | Direct but safe | More polite/formal
Ask a friend | Can you help me with this? | -
Ask a teacher | Could you please give me some advice? | I would appreciate it if you could...
Disagree | I see your point, but... | I understand the concern; however, ...
Refuse | Sorry, I can't make it. | I'm afraid I won't be able to attend.
应用文先问：我是谁？写给谁？目的是什么？需要多正式？ 不要把给朋友和给校长的语气写成一样。
